parsed.name: S7通信伙伴节点
parsed.description: 一种基于西门子 S7 通信协议的工业通信节点，用于在 PLC、工业控制器或上位机之间通过工业以太网进行点对点数据交换。该类设备或通信端点可工作在主动连接或被动监听模式，适合实验室自动化与工业集成场景中的异步数据收发、联机状态监测和参数配置。
parsed.description_en: An industrial communication endpoint based on the Siemens S7 protocol, used for peer-to-peer data exchange between PLCs, industrial controllers, or supervisory computers over Industrial Ethernet. This type of device or communication node can operate in active or passive connection modes and is suitable for lab automation and industrial integration tasks involving asynchronous data transfer, connection status monitoring, and parameter configuration.
